title: The Unquiet Witness
author: I. M. Delacroix
blurb: Hazel Iversen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
